"""Hosted form and Slack OIDC. No credential bodies or access URLs are logged."""
import asyncio
import hmac
import json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlencode, urlsplit

from aiohttp import web, ClientSession, ClientTimeout
import jwt

from .store import AccessError, SESSION_TTL_SECONDS

SECURITY_HEADERS = {
    'Cache-Control':'no-store', 'Referrer-Policy':'no-referrer',
    'X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff', 'X-Frame-Options':'DENY',
    'Content-Security-Policy':"default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'",
}


def verify_slack_token(token, key, audience, nonce):
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token,key,algorithms=['RS256'],audience=audience,
                            issuer='https://slack.com',options={'require':['exp','iat','iss','aud','nonce','sub']})
        if not hmac.compare_digest(str(claims['nonce']),nonce):
            raise ValueError('nonce')
        identity={'team':claims['https://slack.com/team_id'],'owner':claims['https://slack.com/user_id']}
        if not all(isinstance(value,str) and value for value in identity.values()):
            raise ValueError('identity')
        return identity
    except (jwt.PyJWTError,ValueError,KeyError):
        raise AccessError('Slack sign-in could not be verified.',403) from None


class VaultWeb:
    def __init__(self, service, config, *, verify_identity=None):
        self.service, self.store, self.config = service, service.store, config
        self.origin = config['public_url'].rstrip('/')
        parts = urlsplit(self.origin)
        if parts.scheme != 'https' and not config.get('local_test'):
            raise ValueError('The hosted credential form requires HTTPS')
        if parts.path not in ('','/') or parts.query or parts.fragment or parts.username or not parts.hostname:
            raise ValueError('public_url must be a website origin')
        self.verify_identity = verify_identity or self.slack_identity
        self.app = web.Application(client_max_size=16384, middlewares=[self.errors])
        self.app.router.add_get('/vault/fill',self.page)
        self.app.router.add_get('/vault',self.page)
        self.app.router.add_get('/assets/vault.js',self.asset)
        self.app.router.add_get('/assets/vault.css',self.asset)
        self.app.router.add_get('/auth/callback',self.callback)
        self.app.router.add_get('/health',self.health)
        self.app.router.add_post('/auth/start',self.auth_start)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/request',self.request)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/payment/approve',self.payment_approve)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/items',self.items)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/personal/details',self.personal_details)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/personal/remove',self.personal_remove)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/disconnect',self.disconnect)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/invitations',self.invitations)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/invite',self.invite)
        self.app.router.add_post('/api/invite/revoke',self.revoke_invitation)

    @web.middleware
    async def errors(self, request, handler):
        try:
            if request.method=='POST' and request.headers.get('Origin')!=self.origin:
                raise AccessError('This request did not come from the credential form.', 403)
            response = await handler(request)
        except AccessError as exc:
            response = web.json_response({'error':str(exc)},status=exc.status)
        except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,json.JSONDecodeError):
            response = web.json_response({'error':'The request is invalid.'},status=400)
        except web.HTTPException as exc:
            response = web.Response(body=exc.body,status=exc.status,headers=exc.headers)
        except Exception:
            # Never echo exception bodies: a vault/provider exception may contain input.
            response = web.json_response({'error':'Could not complete this operation. Your task is still saved.'},status=503)
        response.headers.update(SECURITY_HEADERS)
        if not self.config.get('local_test'):
            response.headers['Strict-Transport-Security']='max-age=31536000'
        return response

    async def health(self, request):
        return web.json_response({'ready':True})

    async def page(self, request):
        return web.Response(text=Path(__file__).with_name('page.html').read_text(),content_type='text/html')

    async def asset(self, request):
        name = request.path.rsplit('/',1)[-1]
        return web.Response(text=Path(__file__).with_name(name).read_text(),content_type='text/javascript' if name.endswith('.js') else 'text/css')

    def identity(self, request, *, csrf=False):
        identity = self.store.session(request.cookies.get('__Host-clanker',''))
        self.service.validate_member(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        if csrf and not hmac.compare_digest(request.headers.get('X-CSRF-Token',''),identity['csrf']):
            raise AccessError('The form session could not be verified. Reload the page.',403)
        return identity

    async def auth_start(self, request):
        data = await request.json()
        row = self.store.get(data['id'],data['token']) if data else None
        if row:self.service.validate_member(row['team'],row['owner'])
        state,browser,nonce = self.store.start_auth(row['id'] if row else '')
        query = urlencode({'response_type':'code','scope':'openid profile','client_id':self.config['client_id'],
                           'state':state,'nonce':nonce,'team':row['team'] if row else self.service.policy.team,
                           'redirect_uri':self.origin+'/auth/callback'})
        response = web.json_response({'url':'https://slack.com/openid/connect/authorize?'+query})
        response.set_cookie('__Host-clanker-auth',browser,secure=True,httponly=True,samesite='Lax',max_age=600,path='/')
        return response

    async def slack_identity(self, code, nonce):
        from agent.secret_scope import build_profile_secret_scope
        secret = build_profile_secret_scope(self.service.policy.home).get('CLANKER_SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET')
        if not secret:
            raise AccessError('Slack sign-in has not been configured.',503)
        async with ClientSession(timeout=ClientTimeout(total=15)) as client:
            async with client.post('https://slack.com/api/openid.connect.token',data={
                'client_id':self.config['client_id'],'client_secret':secret,'code':code,
                'redirect_uri':self.origin+'/auth/callback'}) as response:
                result = await response.json()
        if not result.get('ok') or not result.get('id_token'):
            raise AccessError('Slack could not verify this sign-in. Open your access link again.',403)
        def decode():
            key = jwt.PyJWKClient('https://slack.com/openid/connect/keys',timeout=10).get_signing_key_from_jwt(result['id_token'])
            return verify_slack_token(result['id_token'],key.key,self.config['client_id'],nonce)
        return await asyncio.to_thread(decode)

    async def callback(self, request):
        auth = self.store.consume_auth(request.query.get('state',''),request.cookies.get('__Host-clanker-auth',''))
        identity = await self.verify_identity(request.query.get('code',''),auth['nonce'])
        if auth['request_id']:self.store.get(auth['request_id'],self.store.token(auth['request_id']),identity=identity)
        self.service.validate_member(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        sid = self.store.new_session(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        response = web.Response(status=302,headers={'Location':'/vault/fill' if auth['request_id'] else '/vault'})
        response.set_cookie('__Host-clanker',sid,secure=True,httponly=True,samesite='Lax',max_age=SESSION_TTL_SECONDS,path='/')
        response.del_cookie('__Host-clanker-auth',path='/')
        return response

    async def request(self, request):
        data = await request.json()
        row = self.store.get(data['id'],data['token'],identity=self.identity(request),waiting=False)
        if row['kind'] == 'payment':
            result = await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.payments.view, data['id'], data['token'], self.identity(request))
            result['csrf'] = self.identity(request)['csrf']
            return web.json_response(result)
        self.service.delegations.request_access(row)
        kernel = getattr(self.service, 'kernel_vault', None)
        if kernel is None:
            raise AccessError('Kernel Vault is not activated. No local collection form is available.', 503)
        managed = getattr(self.service, 'kernel_auth', None)
        is_auth = bool(managed and managed.flow_for_request(row['id'], include_ended=True))
        if is_auth:
            result = await asyncio.to_thread(managed.hosted_view, row)
            result['csrf'] = self.identity(request)['csrf']
            return web.json_response(result)
        url = await asyncio.to_thread(kernel.collection_link, row)
        return web.json_response({'provider': 'kernel', 'collection_url': url,
                                  'csrf': self.identity(request)['csrf']})

    async def payment_approve(self, request):
        identity = self.identity(request, csrf=True)
        data = await request.json()
        if set(data) != {'id', 'token', 'remember', 'approve'}:
            raise AccessError('Only purchase approval and a remember-card choice are accepted.', 400)
        result = await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.approve_payment, data['id'], data['token'], identity,
                                        {'remember': data['remember'], 'approve': data['approve']})
        return web.json_response(result)

    def return_slack_url(self, identity):
        member = self.service.validate_member(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        return 'https://slack.com/app_redirect?'+urlencode({'team':identity['team'],'channel':member['dm_id']})

    async def items(self, request):
        identity = self.identity(request)
        items = await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.delegations.items,identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        personal=await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.personal.store(identity['team'],identity['owner']).summary)
        return web.json_response({'provider':'kernel','items':items,'personal_info':personal,'csrf':identity['csrf']})

    async def personal_details(self, request):
        identity=self.identity(request,csrf=True);data=await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'kind'}:raise AccessError('Choose the personal detail to edit.')
        store=self.service.personal.store(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        if getattr(self.service, 'kernel_vault', None) is None:
            raise AccessError('Kernel Vault is not activated.', 503)
        url=await asyncio.to_thread(store.collection,data['kind'])
        return web.json_response({'provider':'kernel','collection_url':url})

    async def personal_remove(self, request):
        identity=self.identity(request,csrf=True);data=await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'kind'}:raise AccessError('Choose the personal detail to remove.')
        home=self.service.private_home(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        def remove():
            with self.service.lock_for(home):
                store=self.service.personal.store(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
                store.remove(data['kind'])
                return store.summary()
        return web.json_response({'removed':True,'personal_info':await asyncio.to_thread(remove)})

    async def invitations(self, request):
        identity = self.identity(request)
        data = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'handle'}:
            raise AccessError('Choose one of your saved credentials.')
        invitations = await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.delegations.invitations,identity,data['handle'])
        members = await self.service.invitation_members(identity)

    'Cache-Control':'no-store', 'Referrer-Policy':'no-referrer',

def verify_slack_token(token, key, audience, nonce):
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token,key,algorithms=['RS256'],audience=audience,
                            issuer='https://slack.com',options={'require':['exp','iat','iss','aud','nonce','sub']})
        if not hmac.compare_digest(str(claims['nonce']),nonce):
            raise ValueError('nonce')
        identity={'team':claims['https://slack.com/team_id'],'owner':claims['https://slack.com/user_id']}
        if not all(isinstance(value,str) and value for value in identity.values()):
            raise ValueError('identity')
        return identity
    except (jwt.PyJWTError,ValueError,KeyError):
        raise AccessError('Slack sign-in could not be verified.',403) from None

            raise ValueError('The hosted credential form requires HTTPS')
        if parts.path not in ('','/') or parts.query or parts.fragment or parts.username or not parts.hostname:
            raise ValueError('public_url must be a website origin')

Legacy native purchases remain readable/reconcilable through the existing code.
New purchases use native Kernel card handles, never card readback.
"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hmac
import json
import secrets
from string import Template

from .payments import Payments as LegacyPayments
from .store import AccessError


class Payments(LegacyPayments):
    def inventory(self, turn):
        self.service.assert_private(turn)
        with self.service.store.connection() as db:
            saved = db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM kernel_payment_wallets w JOIN kernel_purchases p ON p.wallet_key=w.item_key JOIN requests r ON r.id=p.request_id WHERE w.team=? AND w.owner=? AND r.team=w.team AND r.owner=w.owner AND w.state='active' AND p.remember=1 AND p.approved IS NOT NULL AND p.state NOT IN ('review','approved','creating_wallet','enrollment') LIMIT 1",
                (turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id)).fetchone()
        return {'provider': 'kernel', 'saved': bool(saved)}

    def status(self, turn, *, payment_id):
        result = super().status(turn, payment_id=payment_id)
        _, _, checkout = self._row(payment_id, turn=turn)
        if checkout.get('flow') == 'private_card':
            result['next'] = ('Fill only when ready, then submit once. Observe the merchant result or bank verification; '
                              'use clanker_payment_complete only for an explicit success or definite failure. Never repeat uncertain payment.')
        return result

    def _button(self, turn, plan, selector):
        from tools import browser_vault_tool as native
        # Empty card forms disable Pay until private fill. Bind the visible
        # control now; submit still requires it to be enabled before clicking.
        expression = """(() => {const elements=document.querySelectorAll(SELECTOR);
          if(elements.length!==1)return null;const b=elements[0];
          if(!b.getClientRects().length)return null;
          if(b.tagName==='BUTTON')return b.innerText.trim();
          if(b.tagName==='INPUT'&&b.type==='submit')return b.value.trim();return null;})()""".replace('SELECTOR', json.dumps(selector))
        response = native._eval_js(plan.task_id, expression)
        label = response.get('result') if response.get('success') else None
        if not isinstance(label, str) or not label:
            raise AccessError('Select the visible final payment button.', 409)
        return label

    def receipt(self, turn, **kwargs):
        _, _, checkout = self._row(kwargs['payment_id'], turn=turn)
        if checkout.get('flow') == 'private_card':
            raise AccessError('Use clanker_payment_complete after observing the merchant result.', 409)
        return super().receipt(turn, **kwargs)

    async def request(self, turn, *, merchant_name, amount, pay_button_selector, merchant_country='IN'):
        """Call only for the owner's current instruction to proceed with payment."""
        self.service.assert_private(turn)
        self.service.delegations.check_execution(turn)
        if (not isinstance(merchant_name, str) or not merchant_name.strip() or len(merchant_name) > 120
                or type(amount) is not int or not 0 < amount <= 50000 or merchant_country != 'IN'):
            raise AccessError('Provide the merchant and INR amount in paise (Kernel maximum ₹500).', 400)
        if not isinstance(pay_button_selector, str) or not 0 < len(pay_button_selector) <= 4096:
            raise AccessError('Select the final payment button.', 400)
        with self.service.lock_for(turn.home):
            plan = self.service.kernel_vault.inspect(turn)
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                unresolved = db.execute("SELECT r.id FROM requests r JOIN kernel_purchases p ON r.id=p.request_id WHERE r.team=? AND r.owner=? AND p.state NOT IN ('completed','cancelled','review') LIMIT 1",
                    (turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id)).fetchone()
                wallet = db.execute('SELECT * FROM kernel_payment_wallets WHERE team=? AND owner=?',
                    (turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id)).fetchone()
                remembered = bool(wallet and db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM kernel_purchases p JOIN requests r ON r.id=p.request_id WHERE r.team=? AND r.owner=? AND p.wallet_key=? AND p.remember=1 AND p.approved IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1',
                    (turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id, wallet['item_key'])).fetchone())
            if unresolved:
                raise AccessError('Reconcile the existing payment before starting another.', 409)
            if wallet and wallet['state'] != 'active':
                raise AccessError('Previous card enrollment/removal needs reconciliation.', 409)
            vault = self.service.kernel_vault.ensure_vault(turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id)['id']
            checkout = dict(flow='private_card', merchant_name=merchant_name.strip(), amount=amount,
                currency='inr', merchant_country='IN', origin=plan.origin, page_url=plan.page_url,
                browser_id=plan.browser_id, pay_button_selector=pay_button_selector,
                pay_label=self._button(turn, plan, pay_button_selector))
            row = self.service.store.create(team=turn.source.scope_id, owner=turn.source.user_id,
                home=self.service.private_home(turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id), task_id=turn.task_id,
                source=turn.source.to_dict(), task=turn.message, kind='payment',
                label=f'{merchant_name.strip()} · Pay ₹{amount / 100:.2f}', origin=plan.origin,
                checkout=checkout, gateway_event_id=turn.message_id)
            key = wallet['item_key'] if wallet else 'wallet-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO kernel_purchases VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,NULL)',
                    (row['id'], wallet['vault'] if wallet else vault, key, 'purchase-' + row['id'],
                     'approved' if remembered else 'review', 1 if remembered else None,
                     self.service.store.clock() if remembered else None, None))
            if remembered:
                _, purchase, _ = self._row(row['id'], turn=turn)
                try:
                    self._drive(row, purchase)
                except AccessError as error:
                    if getattr(error, 'kernel_vault_code', None) in {'invalid_request', 'forbidden', 'authentication_failed'}:
                        self._state(row['id'], 'provider_rejected')
                        with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                            db.execute("UPDATE requests SET status='resumed',resume_delivered=? WHERE id=?",
                                       (self.service.store.clock(), row['id']))
                        return dict(payment_id=row['id'], status='blocked', state='provider_rejected')
                    # Retain uncertain mutation claims for read-only reconciliation.
                except Exception:
                    pass
                state = self._row(row['id'], turn=turn)[1]['state']
                if state == 'ready':
                    self.service.store.mark_resumed(row['id'])
                    return dict(payment_id=row['id'], status='ready', state='ready', remembered=True)
        state = self._row(row['id'], turn=turn)[1]['state']
        delivery = await self.service.deliver_link(row, **({'delivery_event_id': 'native-spend-approval-' + row['id']} if state == 'approval' else {}))
        return dict(delivery, status='waiting_for_owner', payment_id=row['id'],
                    link_delivery=delivery.get('status', 'unconfirmed'))

    def _observe(self, turn, checkout=None, **kwargs):
        if not checkout or checkout.get('flow') != 'private_card':
            return super()._observe(turn, checkout, **kwargs)
        plan = self.service.kernel_vault.inspect(turn, checkout['origin'])
        if plan.page_url != checkout['page_url'] or plan.browser_id != checkout['browser_id']:
            raise AccessError('The payment page or browser changed.', 409)
        return plan, checkout['amount'], ''

    def view(self, request_id, token, identity):
        if not isinstance(token, str) or not hmac.compare_digest(token, self.service.store.token(request_id)):
            raise AccessError('This payment link is invalid.', 404)
        row, purchase, checkout = self._row(request_id, identity=identity)
        if checkout.get('flow') != 'private_card':
            return super().view(request_id, token, identity)
        result = dict(provider='kernel_payment', payment_id=request_id, state=purchase['state'],
                      merchant=checkout['merchant_name'], amount=checkout['amount'], currency='inr')
        if purchase['state'] in {'creating_otp', 'otp', 'otp_ready'}:
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                verification = db.execute('SELECT * FROM kernel_payment_verifications WHERE request_id=?', (request_id,)).fetchone()
            if verification:
                item = self.service.kernel_vault.client.get_credential(purchase['vault'], verification['item_key'])
                if item and item['state']['status'] == 'pending_collection':
                    item = self.service.kernel_vault.client.collect(purchase['vault'], verification['item_key'])
                if item and item.get('action'):
                    result['collection_url'] = item['action']['url']
        elif purchase['state'] in {'enrollment', 'approval'}:
            kind = 'wallet' if purchase['state'] == 'enrollment' else 'card'
            key = purchase['wallet_key'] if kind == 'wallet' else purchase['card_key']
            item = self.client.get_payment(purchase['vault'], key, kind)
            if item and item.get('action'):
                result['collection_url'] = item['action']['url']
        return result

    def submit(self, turn, *, payment_id):
        from tools import browser_vault_tool as native
        row, purchase, checkout = self._row(payment_id, turn=turn)
        if checkout.get('flow') != 'private_card':
            return super().submit(turn, payment_id=payment_id)
        with self.service.lock_for(turn.home):
            if row['expires'] <= self.service.store.clock():
                raise AccessError('Payment request expired.', 410)
            plan, _, _ = self._observe(turn, checkout)
            card = self.client.get_payment(purchase['vault'], purchase['card_key'], 'card')
            if (not card or card['state']['status'] != 'ready' or not card.get('expires_at')
                    or datetime.fromisoformat(card['expires_at'].replace('Z', '+00:00')) <= datetime.now(timezone.utc)):
                raise AccessError('Payment credentials expired.', 409)
            self._claim(payment_id, 'filled', 'submitting')
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                db.execute('UPDATE kernel_purchases SET submitted=? WHERE request_id=?', (self.service.store.clock(), payment_id))
            expression = '''(() => {if(location.href!==$url||window.__hermesNativePageBinding!==$marker)return false;
              const buttons=document.querySelectorAll($selector);if(buttons.length!==1)return false;
              const b=buttons[0];if(!b.getClientRects().length||b.disabled)return false;
              if(b.tagName!=='BUTTON'&&!(b.tagName==='INPUT'&&b.type==='submit'))return false;
              const label=b.tagName==='BUTTON'?b.innerText:b.value;if(label.trim()!==$label)return false;
              b.click();return true;})()'''
            expression = Template(expression).substitute(url=json.dumps(plan.page_url), marker=json.dumps(plan.marker),
                selector=json.dumps(checkout['pay_button_selector']), label=json.dumps(checkout['pay_label']))
            response = native._eval_js(plan.task_id, expression)
            if response.get('success') and response.get('result') is False:
                self._state(payment_id, 'submit_blocked')
                with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                    db.execute('UPDATE kernel_purchases SET submitted=NULL WHERE request_id=?', (payment_id,))
            else:
                self._state(payment_id, 'submitted_unknown')
            return dict(payment_id=payment_id, state=self._row(payment_id, turn=turn)[1]['state'],
                        next='Check the merchant outcome or bank verification. Never repeat an uncertain payment.')

    def complete(self, turn, *, payment_id, outcome):
        """Agent reports the merchant outcome after observing the browser."""
        with self.service.lock_for(turn.home):
            row, purchase, checkout = self._row(payment_id, turn=turn)
            if checkout.get('flow') != 'private_card':
                raise AccessError('Use the legacy reconciliation path for this existing purchase.', 409)
            if outcome not in {'paid', 'failed'} or purchase['state'] not in {'submitted_unknown', 'otp_submitted_unknown'}:
                raise AccessError('Confirm the merchant outcome of the submitted payment first.', 409)
            plan = self.service.kernel_vault.inspect(turn, checkout['origin'])
            if plan.browser_id != checkout['browser_id']:
                raise AccessError('Payment browser changed.', 403)
            # Remove filled controls, including frames, before lifting privacy guards.
            self.service.cloud_browser.stop(turn)
            self._state(payment_id, 'completed')
            pending = False
            if not purchase['remember']:
                try:
                    self._remove_wallet(row, purchase)
                except Exception:
                    pending = True
            return dict(payment_id=payment_id, state='completed', outcome=outcome, card_removal_pending=pending)

async def authenticated_owner(f, owner='UA'):
    turn = f.turn(owner)
    waiting = await f.auth.authenticate(turn, origin=ORIGIN)
    donor = remote_result(f, waiting['request_id'])
    f.auth.poll()
    f.service.store.mark_resumed(waiting['request_id'])
    return waiting, donor

from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hmac
import json
import secrets
from string import Template

from .payments import Payments as LegacyPayments
from .store import AccessError


class Payments(LegacyPayments):
    def inventory(self, turn):
        self.service.assert_private(turn)
        with self.service.store.connection() as db:
            saved = db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM kernel_payment_wallets w JOIN kernel_purchases p ON p.wallet_key=w.item_key JOIN requests r ON r.id=p.request_id WHERE w.team=? AND w.owner=? AND r.team=w.team AND r.owner=w.owner AND w.state='active' AND p.remember=1 AND p.approved IS NOT NULL AND p.state NOT IN ('review','approved','creating_wallet','enrollment') LIMIT 1",
                (turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id)).fetchone()
        return {'provider': 'kernel', 'saved': bool(saved)}

    def status(self, turn, *, payment_id):
        result = super().status(turn, payment_id=payment_id)
        _, _, checkout = self._row(payment_id, turn=turn)
        if checkout.get('flow') == 'private_card':
            result['next'] = ('Fill only when ready, then submit once. Observe the merchant result or bank verification; '
                              'use clanker_payment_complete only for an explicit success or definite failure. Never repeat uncertain payment.')
        return result

    def _button(self, turn, plan, selector):
        from tools import browser_vault_tool as native
        # Empty card forms disable Pay until private fill. Bind the visible
        # control now; submit still requires it to be enabled before clicking.
        expression = """(() => {const elements=document.querySelectorAll(SELECTOR);
          if(elements.length!==1)return null;const b=elements[0];
          if(!b.getClientRects().length)return null;
          if(b.tagName==='BUTTON')return b.innerText.trim();
          if(b.tagName==='INPUT'&&b.type==='submit')return b.value.trim();return null;})()""".replace('SELECTOR', json.dumps(selector))
        response = native._eval_js(plan.task_id, expression)
        label = response.get('result') if response.get('success') else None
        if not isinstance(label, str) or not label:
            raise AccessError('Select the visible final payment button.', 409)
        return label

    def receipt(self, turn, **kwargs):
        _, _, checkout = self._row(kwargs['payment_id'], turn=turn)
        if checkout.get('flow') == 'private_card':
            raise AccessError('Use clanker_payment_complete after observing the merchant result.', 409)
        return super().receipt(turn, **kwargs)

    async def request(self, turn, *, merchant_name, amount, pay_button_selector, merchant_country='IN'):
        """Call only for the owner's current instruction to proceed with payment."""
        self.service.assert_private(turn)
        self.service.delegations.check_execution(turn)
        if (not isinstance(merchant_name, str) or not merchant_name.strip() or len(merchant_name) > 120
                or type(amount) is not int or not 0 < amount <= 50000 or merchant_country != 'IN'):
            raise AccessError('Provide the merchant and INR amount in paise (Kernel maximum ₹500).', 400)
        if not isinstance(pay_button_selector, str) or not 0 < len(pay_button_selector) <= 4096:
            raise AccessError('Select the final payment button.', 400)
        with self.service.lock_for(turn.home):
            plan = self.service.kernel_vault.inspect(turn)
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                unresolved = db.execute("SELECT r.id FROM requests r JOIN kernel_purchases p ON r.id=p.request_id WHERE r.team=? AND r.owner=? AND p.state NOT IN ('completed','cancelled','review') LIMIT 1",
                    (turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id)).fetchone()
                wallet = db.execute('SELECT * FROM kernel_payment_wallets WHERE team=? AND owner=?',
                    (turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id)).fetchone()
                remembered = bool(wallet and db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM kernel_purchases p JOIN requests r ON r.id=p.request_id WHERE r.team=? AND r.owner=? AND p.wallet_key=? AND p.remember=1 AND p.approved IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1',
                    (turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id, wallet['item_key'])).fetchone())
            if unresolved:
                raise AccessError('Reconcile the existing payment before starting another.', 409)
            if wallet and wallet['state'] != 'active':
                raise AccessError('Previous card enrollment/removal needs reconciliation.', 409)
            vault = self.service.kernel_vault.ensure_vault(turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id)['id']
            checkout = dict(flow='private_card', merchant_name=merchant_name.strip(), amount=amount,
                currency='inr', merchant_country='IN', origin=plan.origin, page_url=plan.page_url,
                browser_id=plan.browser_id, pay_button_selector=pay_button_selector,
                pay_label=self._button(turn, plan, pay_button_selector))
            row = self.service.store.create(team=turn.source.scope_id, owner=turn.source.user_id,
                home=self.service.private_home(turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id), task_id=turn.task_id,
                source=turn.source.to_dict(), task=turn.message, kind='payment',
                label=f'{merchant_name.strip()} · Pay ₹{amount / 100:.2f}', origin=plan.origin,
                checkout=checkout, gateway_event_id=turn.message_id)
            key = wallet['item_key'] if wallet else 'wallet-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO kernel_purchases VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,NULL)',
                    (row['id'], wallet['vault'] if wallet else vault, key, 'purchase-' + row['id'],
                     'approved' if remembered else 'review', 1 if remembered else None,
                     self.service.store.clock() if remembered else None, None))
            if remembered:
                _, purchase, _ = self._row(row['id'], turn=turn)
                try:
                    self._drive(row, purchase)
                except AccessError as error:
                    if getattr(error, 'kernel_vault_code', None) in {'invalid_request', 'forbidden', 'authentication_failed'}:
                        self._state(row['id'], 'provider_rejected')
                        with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                            db.execute("UPDATE requests SET status='resumed',resume_delivered=? WHERE id=?",
                                       (self.service.store.clock(), row['id']))
                        return dict(payment_id=row['id'], status='blocked', state='provider_rejected')
                    # Retain uncertain mutation claims for read-only reconciliation.
                except Exception:

        state = self._row(row['id'], turn=turn)[1]['state']
        delivery = await self.service.deliver_link(row, **({'delivery_event_id': 'native-spend-approval-' + row['id']} if state == 'approval' else {}))
        return dict(delivery, status='waiting_for_owner', payment_id=row['id'],
                    link_delivery=delivery.get('status', 'unconfirmed'))

    def _observe(self, turn, checkout=None, **kwargs):
        if not checkout or checkout.get('flow') != 'private_card':
            return super()._observe(turn, checkout, **kwargs)
        plan = self.service.kernel_vault.inspect(turn, checkout['origin'])
        if plan.page_url != checkout['page_url'] or plan.browser_id != checkout['browser_id']:
            raise AccessError('The payment page or browser changed.', 409)
        return plan, checkout['amount'], ''

    def view(self, request_id, token, identity):
        if not isinstance(token, str) or not hmac.compare_digest(token, self.service.store.token(request_id)):
            raise AccessError('This payment link is invalid.', 404)
        row, purchase, checkout = self._row(request_id, identity=identity)
        if checkout.get('flow') != 'private_card':
            return super().view(request_id, token, identity)
        result = dict(provider='kernel_payment', payment_id=request_id, state=purchase['state'],
                      merchant=checkout['merchant_name'], amount=checkout['amount'], currency='inr')
        if purchase['state'] in {'creating_otp', 'otp', 'otp_ready'}:
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                verification = db.execute('SELECT * FROM kernel_payment_verifications WHERE request_id=?', (request_id,)).fetchone()
            if verification:
                item = self.service.kernel_vault.client.get_credential(purchase['vault'], verification['item_key'])
                if item and item['state']['status'] == 'pending_collection':
                    item = self.service.kernel_vault.client.collect(purchase['vault'], verification['item_key'])
                if item and item.get('action'):
                    result['collection_url'] = item['action']['url']
        elif purchase['state'] in {'enrollment', 'approval'}:
            kind = 'wallet' if purchase['state'] == 'enrollment' else 'card'
            key = purchase['wallet_key'] if kind == 'wallet' else purchase['card_key']
            item = self.client.get_payment(purchase['vault'], key, kind)
            if item and item.get('action'):
                result['collection_url'] = item['action']['url']
        return result

    def submit(self, turn, *, payment_id):
        from tools import browser_vault_tool as native
        row, purchase, checkout = self._row(payment_id, turn=turn)
        if checkout.get('flow') != 'private_card':
            return super().submit(turn, payment_id=payment_id)
        with self.service.lock_for(turn.home):
            if row['expires'] <= self.service.store.clock():
                raise AccessError('Payment request expired.', 410)
            plan, _, _ = self._observe(turn, checkout)
            card = self.client.get_payment(purchase['vault'], purchase['card_key'], 'card')
            if (not card or card['state']['status'] != 'ready' or not card.get('expires_at')
                    or datetime.fromisoformat(card['expires_at'].replace('Z', '+00:00')) <= datetime.now(timezone.utc)):
                raise AccessError('Payment credentials expired.', 409)
            self._claim(payment_id, 'filled', 'submitting')
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                db.execute('UPDATE kernel_purchases SET submitted=? WHERE request_id=?', (self.service.store.clock(), payment_id))
            expression = '''(() => {if(location.href!==$url||window.__hermesNativePageBinding!==$marker)return false;
              const buttons=document.querySelectorAll($selector);if(buttons.length!==1)return false;
              const b=buttons[0];if(!b.getClientRects().length||b.disabled)return false;
              if(b.tagName!=='BUTTON'&&!(b.tagName==='INPUT'&&b.type==='submit'))return false;
              const label=b.tagName==='BUTTON'?b.innerText:b.value;if(label.trim()!==$label)return false;
              b.click();return true;})()'''
            expression = Template(expression).substitute(url=json.dumps(plan.page_url), marker=json.dumps(plan.marker),
                selector=json.dumps(checkout['pay_button_selector']), label=json.dumps(checkout['pay_label']))
            response = native._eval_js(plan.task_id, expression)
            if response.get('success') and response.get('result') is False:
                self._state(payment_id, 'submit_blocked')
                with self.service.store.connection() as db:
                    db.execute('UPDATE kernel_purchases SET submitted=NULL WHERE request_id=?', (payment_id,))
            else:
                self._state(payment_id, 'submitted_unknown')
            return dict(payment_id=payment_id, state=self._row(payment_id, turn=turn)[1]['state'],
                        next='Check the merchant outcome or bank verification. Never repeat an uncertain payment.')

    def complete(self, turn, *, payment_id, outcome):
        """Agent reports the merchant outcome after observing the browser."""
        with self.service.lock_for(turn.home):
            row, purchase, checkout = self._row(payment_id, turn=turn)
            if checkout.get('flow') != 'private_card':
                raise AccessError('Use the legacy reconciliation path for this existing purchase.', 409)
            if outcome not in {'paid', 'failed'} or purchase['state'] not in {'submitted_unknown', 'otp_submitted_unknown'}:
                raise AccessError('Confirm the merchant outcome of the submitted payment first.', 409)
            plan = self.service.kernel_vault.inspect(turn, checkout['origin'])
            if plan.browser_id != checkout['browser_id']:
                raise AccessError('Payment browser changed.', 403)
            # Remove filled controls, including frames, before lifting privacy guards.
            self.service.cloud_browser.stop(turn)
            self._state(payment_id, 'completed')
            pending = False
            if not purchase['remember']:
                try:
                    self._remove_wallet(row, purchase)
                except Exception:
                    pending = True
            return dict(payment_id=payment_id, state='completed', outcome=outcome, card_removal_pending=pending)

def displayed_amount(text):
    """INR only: require a single unambiguous decimal amount in a total element."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise AccessError('The checkout total could not be verified.', 409)
    if re.search(r'-\s*\d', text):
        raise AccessError('A positive checkout total is required.',409)
    numbers = re.findall(r'\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,2})?', text)
    if len(numbers) != 1:
        raise AccessError('Select a checkout total containing exactly one amount.', 409)
    try:
        value = Decimal(numbers[0].replace(',', '')) * 100
        if value != value.to_integral_value():
            raise ValueError
        return int(value)
    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
        raise AccessError('The checkout total could not be verified.', 409) from None

# Payment instructions and remembered cards

New payments no longer collect item summaries, total-element selectors, receipt
text or receipt selectors. The agent supplies the observed amount in paise for
the Pay ₹X card and Kernel's purchase contract. The harness does not regex the
checkout or freeze its item text. Browser, URL, final button and one-attempt
submission binding remain. Amount accuracy relies on the agent's observation.

The owner asking to proceed with payment authorizes use of a remembered card.
If Kernel returns ready, continue immediately without another Clanker approval
page. Otherwise show the required private provider step. Without a remembered
card, show Pay ₹X with a remember choice and open Kernel-hosted card enrollment.
No card values are stored locally or accepted through ordinary tool arguments.

Use native Kernel wallet/card items. Kernel prohibits credit-card data in generic
credential items. Mastercard needs no hosted spend approval; Visa requires a
passkey spend approval even for a remembered card. Native purchases remain limited
to 50,000 minor units (₹500). These are upstream constraints, not extra Clanker
approval rules.

New completion uses the agent's observation of explicit merchant success or a
definite failure, without receipt parsing. A click is not success. Unknown
outcomes remain unresolved and cannot be replayed. Close the owned browser before
releasing privacy guards; remove temporary cards after resolution. Existing
legacy purchases retain their old reconciliation path.

The payment page has no receipt wording. Local fixture checks do not establish
real issuer/merchant acceptance. No live restart, enrollment or payment was made.

- https://github.com/kernel/cli (Vaults: card data must not use credential items)
- https://github.com/kernel/kernel-python-sdk/blob/main/src/kernel/types/vaults/kernel_card_vault_item_spec.py
- https://github.com/kernel/kernel-python-sdk/blob/main/src/kernel/types/vaults/kernel_card_state.py

class Provider:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items={};self.calls=[];self.fail=None;self.visa=False;self.fill_status='completed'
    def get_payment(self,vault,key,kind):
        self.calls.append(('get',kind,key));return deepcopy(self.items.get(key))
    def create_wallet(self,vault,key):
        self.calls.append(('wallet',key))
        item=dict(id='id-'+key,key=key,type='wallet',state={'provider':'kernel','status':'pending_authorization'},
            available_operations=[],eligible=False,action={'name':'card_enrollment','url':'https://vault.kernel.sh/enroll?private=1'})
        self.items[key]=item

    def connect(self,key):
        self.items[key]['state']['status']='connected';self.items[key]['eligible']=True
    def create_card(self,vault,key,**kwargs):
        self.calls.append(('card',key,kwargs))
        item=dict(id='id-'+key,key=key,type='card',state={'provider':'kernel','status':'requested'},
            available_operations=[{'type':'authorize'}],eligible=False)
        self.items[key]=item
        if self.fail=='card':raise TimeoutError()
        return deepcopy(item)
    def authorize_card(self,vault,key):
        self.calls.append(('authorize',key))
        self.items[key]['state']['status']='pending_authorization' if self.visa else 'ready'
        self.items[key]['available_operations']=[{'type':'fill'}]
        self.items[key]['expires_at']=(datetime.now(timezone.utc)+timedelta(minutes=10)).isoformat()
        if self.visa:self.items[key]['action']={'name':'spend_approval','url':'https://vault.kernel.sh/approve?private=1'}
        if self.fail=='authorize':raise TimeoutError()
        return deepcopy(self.items[key])
    def fill_card(self,vault,key,**kwargs):
        self.calls.append(('fill',key,kwargs))
        if self.fail=='fill':raise TimeoutError()
        return {'type':'fill','status':self.fill_status,'fields':[]}
    def delete_credential(self,vault,key):
        self.calls.append(('delete',key))
        if self.fail=='delete':raise TimeoutError()
        self.items.pop(key,None);return True


class PaymentSession(Session):
    """Model Kernel rejecting method expansion before wallet authorization."""
    def wallet(self, key='wallet-fixture', *, status='pending_authorization', expansions=()):
        self.item = dict(id='id-'+key, key=key, type='wallet', spec={'provider':'kernel'},
            state={'provider':'kernel','status':status}, available_operations=[],
            available_expansions=[{'type':kind,'description':'private-expansion-description'} for kind in expansions])
        if status == 'pending_authorization':
            self.item['action'] = {'name':'card_enrollment','url':'https://vault.kernel.sh/enroll?private=1'}

    def request(self, method, url, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append((method, url, deepcopy(kwargs)))
        assert method == 'GET' and url.endswith('/items/'+self.item['key'])
        if kwargs['params'] is None:
            return Response(200, self.item)
        assert kwargs['params'] == {'expand':'payment_methods'}
        if (self.item['type'] != 'wallet' or self.item['state']['status'] != 'connected' or
                not any(expansion['type']=='payment_methods' for expansion in self.item['available_expansions'])):
            return Response(409, {'message':'wallet is pending_authorization'})
        expanded = deepcopy(self.item)
        expanded['expanded'] = {'payment_methods':[{'id':'private-method','number':'private-card',
            'capabilities':{'single_use_card':{'eligible':True}}}]}
        return Response(200, expanded)

# Payment instructions and remembered cards

New payments no longer collect item summaries, total-element selectors, receipt
text or receipt selectors. The agent supplies the observed amount in paise for
the Pay ₹X card and Kernel's purchase contract. The harness does not regex the
checkout or freeze its item text. Browser, URL, final button and one-attempt
submission binding remain. Amount accuracy relies on the agent's observation.

The owner asking to proceed with payment authorizes use of a remembered card.
If Kernel returns ready, continue immediately without another Clanker approval
page. Otherwise show the required private provider step. Without a remembered
card, show Pay ₹X with a remember choice and open Kernel-hosted card enrollment.
No card values are stored locally or accepted through ordinary tool arguments.

Use native Kernel wallet/card items. Kernel prohibits credit-card data in generic
credential items. Mastercard needs no hosted spend approval; Visa requires a
passkey spend approval even for a remembered card. Native purchases remain limited
to 50,000 minor units (₹500). These are upstream constraints, not extra Clanker
approval rules.

New completion uses the agent's observation of explicit merchant success or a
definite failure, without receipt parsing. A click is not success. Unknown
outcomes remain unresolved and cannot be replayed. Close the owned browser before
releasing privacy guards; remove temporary cards after resolution. Existing
legacy purchases retain their old reconciliation path.

The payment page has no receipt wording. Local fixture checks do not establish
real issuer/merchant acceptance. No live restart, enrollment or payment was made.

class Provider:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items={};self.calls=[];self.fail=None;self.visa=False;self.fill_status='completed'
    def get_payment(self,vault,key,kind):
        self.calls.append(('get',kind,key));return deepcopy(self.items.get(key))
    def create_wallet(self,vault,key):
        self.calls.append(('wallet',key))
        item=dict(id='id-'+key,key=key,type='wallet',state={'provider':'kernel','status':'pending_authorization'},
            available_operations=[],eligible=False,action={'name':'card_enrollment','url':'https://vault.kernel.sh/enroll?private=1'})
        self.items[key]=item
        if self.fail=='wallet':raise TimeoutError()
        return deepcopy(item)
    def connect(self,key):
        self.items[key]['state']['status']='connected';self.items[key]['eligible']=True
    def create_card(self,vault,key,**kwargs):
        self.calls.append(('card',key,kwargs))
        item=dict(id='id-'+key,key=key,type='card',state={'provider':'kernel','status':'requested'},
            available_operations=[{'type':'authorize'}],eligible=False)
        self.items[key]=item
        if self.fail=='card':raise TimeoutError()
        return deepcopy(item)
    def authorize_card(self,vault,key):
        self.calls.append(('authorize',key))
        self.items[key]['state']['status']='pending_authorization' if self.visa else 'ready'
        self.items[key]['available_operations']=[{'type':'fill'}]
        self.items[key]['expires_at']=(datetime.now(timezone.utc)+timedelta(minutes=10)).isoformat()
        if self.visa:self.items[key]['action']={'name':'spend_approval','url':'https://vault.kernel.sh/approve?private=1'}
        if self.fail=='authorize':raise TimeoutError()
        return deepcopy(self.items[key])
    def fill_card(self,vault,key,**kwargs):
        self.calls.append(('fill',key,kwargs))
        if self.fail=='fill':raise TimeoutError()
        return {'type':'fill','status':self.fill_status,'fields':[]}
    def delete_credential(self,vault,key):
        self.calls.append(('delete',key))
        if self.fail=='delete':raise TimeoutError()
        self.items.pop(key,None);return True


class PaymentSession(Session):
    """Model Kernel rejecting method expansion before wallet authorization."""
    def wallet(self, key='wallet-fixture', *, status='pending_authorization', expansions=()):
        self.item = dict(id='id-'+key, key=key, type='wallet', spec={'provider':'kernel'},
            state={'provider':'kernel','status':status}, available_operations=[],
            available_expansions=[{'type':kind,'description':'private-expansion-description'} for kind in expansions])
        if status == 'pending_authorization':
            self.item['action'] = {'name':'card_enrollment','url':'https://vault.kernel.sh/enroll?private=1'}

    def request(self, method, url, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append((method, url, deepcopy(kwargs)))
        assert method == 'GET' and url.endswith('/items/'+self.item['key'])
        if kwargs['params'] is None:
            return Response(200, self.item)
        assert kwargs['params'] == {'expand':'payment_methods'}
        if (self.item['type'] != 'wallet' or self.item['state']['status'] != 'connected' or
                not any(expansion['type']=='payment_methods' for expansion in self.item['available_expansions'])):
            return Response(409, {'message':'wallet is pending_authorization'})
        expanded = deepcopy(self.item)
        expanded['expanded'] = {'payment_methods':[{'id':'private-method','number':'private-card',
            'capabilities':{'single_use_card':{'eligible':True}}}]}
        return Response(200, expanded)

def _drive(self, row, purchase):
        """Mutation claims survive crashes. Polling reconciles only known item keys."""
        pid, vault, wallet_key, card_key = row['id'], purchase['vault'], purchase['wallet_key'], purchase['card_key']
        state = purchase['state']
        if state in {'creating_otp', 'otp'}:
            with self.service.store.connection() as db:

            if verification:

        if state == 'approved':

            if wallet is None:

                    db.execute('INSERT INTO kernel_payment_wallets VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',

ORIGIN = 'https://api.example.com'


def saved_api(f, owner='UA', *, dedicated=False, value=None, kind='api_key'):
    turn = f.turn(owner, origin=ORIGIN)
    own = f.k.ensure_vault('TT', owner)
    handle, key = 'api-account-' + owner, 'api-item-' + owner
    vault = own
    if dedicated:
        vault = f.remote.create_vault('dedicated-api-' + owner)
        f.k.metadata.bind_credential_vault('TT', owner, turn.home, handle, vault['id'])
    value = value if value is not None else 'SYNTHETIC_API_SECRET_' + owner + '_41ba9'
    remote = f.remote.create_credential(vault['id'], key, [
        {'name': 'api_key', 'type': 'text', 'required': True, 'sensitive': False, 'value': value}])
    record = f.k.metadata.put_item('TT', owner, turn.home, handle, key, remote['id'],
        kind, 'Synthetic API', ORIGIN, fields=['api_key'], status='ready',
        version=remote['version'], vault_id=vault['id'])
    return turn, record, value


def remote_item(f, record):
    return f.remote.items[record['vault_id'], record['key']]


def assert_no_retained_value(f, value):
    for turn_owner in ('UA', 'UB'):
        turn = f.turn(turn_owner, origin=ORIGIN)

    assert not f.remote.fills
    assert value.encode() not in f.service.store.path.read_bytes()
    assert not list(f.service.policy.home.rglob('vault.json.enc'))

async def run_case(stop):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='clanker-auth-audit-') as directory, pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
        service = service_fixture.__wrapped__(Path(directory))
        f = managed_fixture.__wrapped__(service, patch)

        except AccessError:

        with service.store.connection() as db:

        f.remote.fail = None
        trace = {'initial_state': initial['state'], 'remote_connection_count': len(f.remote.connections)}
        if stop:
            # The same state operations performed by gateway /stop and Kernel.stop.
            service.store.cancel(team='TT', owner='UA', source=f.turn().source.to_dict())
            try:
                f.auth.release_context('TT','UA',f.turn().home,thread=service.cloud_browser.thread(f.turn()))

            f.auth.poll()
        try:

            trace['retry_result'] = result['status']
        except AccessError as error:
            trace['retry_error'] = str(error)
        with service.store.connection() as db:
            latest = dict(db.execute('SELECT * FROM kernel_auth_flows').fetchone())

        if stop:

            assert not any(call[0] in {'find','delete_connection','delete_profile'} for call in f.remote.calls)
            assert trace.get('retry_error') and len(f.remote.connections)==1
        else:
            assert trace['retry_result']=='waiting_for_owner' and latest['state']=='pending'
